Unlawful detainer settlement conference held. Case settled. Parties placed a settlement agreement on the record. The main terms are as follows for premises located at 2595 43rd Ave. SF, CA:
Defendant agrees to a probationary period from 1/14/04-8/1/04.
During this period, Defenadnt will not create a nuisance in the unit and the building.
Defendant will pay back rent in the amount of $2,286 with-in one week.
If Defendant complies with the agreement, dismissal will be filed by Plaintiff.
If the Defendant breaches the agreement, Judgement will be entered for possession of the
said premises.
Plaintiff will provide a written stipulation for entry of judgment in one week and a stipulation for injunction.
Plaintiff requests that a Court Trial remain in effect for 1/20/04 in Dept. #206 as to Defendant Darnise Grodt who did not appear at the settlement confereence.
